channel.title: Robotics Directory - Robotic Arms
channel.description: Browse 561 robotic arms in the Robotics Directory. Specs, prices, images and comparison.

item.title: Enactic OpenArm 2.0
item.description: OpenArm 2.0 is Enactic’s open-source seven-DOF-per-arm platform for physical-AI research, teleoperation and reproducible evaluation. The company dates its launch to May 2026. A compact camera-equipped gripper and changed J5 bracket distinguish it from 1.0, while the upgrade guide retains arm structure, motors and electronics. Reach and mass are per arm; payload ratings include the end effector and depend on short specified tests. Hardware and software use different licenses.

item.title: Dobot PULSA 7
item.description: High-speed industrial collaborative arm launched at the 2026 Shanghai Industrial Expo. It reaches J6 joint speeds of up to 790°/s with ±0.02 mm repeatability, is IP67-rated and has internal cable routing.

item.title: Dobot PULSA 12
item.description: 12 kg version of Dobot's high-speed PULSA industrial cobot, with ±0.03 mm repeatability, IP67 protection and upright, inverted or side mounting.

item.title: Kinova KIMA
item.description: Medical robotic arm built for clinical use rather than adapted from an industrial robot. Kinova targets endoscopy, bronchoscopy and surgical interventions with it. Kinova launched it in 2026 for its 20th anniversary. It sits in the 3 kg payload class and has a frame under 13 kg. Every joint has redundant torque sensors. It has no separate control box: control runs over EtherCAT through a control library. Its software is IEC 62304 Class C.

item.title: Hiwonder NexArm
item.description: NexArm is an open-source ESP32 and AT32-based AI robotic arm platform from Hiwonder for embodied-AI and vision-language-action (VLA) learning. It uses magnetic-encoder bus servos with all-metal gears, supports a leader-follower teleoperation setup compatible with Hugging Face LeRobot for data collection, and adds AI vision and multimodal LLM interaction.

item.title: Yahboom DOFBOT Ultra
item.description: DOFBOT Ultra is a desktop AI robotic arm from Yahboom built on Raspberry Pi 5 or D-Robotics RDK X5 with 3D depth vision and large-language-model integration. Yahboom supplies tutorials covering assembly, motion control, Python, ROS 2, MoveIt and AI computer vision for education and research.

item.title: Seeed Studio reBot Arm B601-DM
item.description: reBot Arm B601-DM is a fully open-source 6-axis robotic arm with a parallel gripper from Seeed Studio, built around Damiao actuators for embodied-AI learning and teleoperation. It offers up to 767 mm reach with the gripper, a 1.5 kg payload and repeatability under 0.2 mm, and Seeed publishes its BOM, drawings, software and algorithms.

item.title: Dobot VEGA 7
item.description: Seven-axis force-controlled arm from Dobot (Shenzhen Yuejiang) aimed at wheeled dual-arm platforms, industrial mobile manipulation and embodied-AI development. It has torque sensors in every joint, a 7 kg rated payload, 725 mm reach, ±0.03 mm repeatability, IP54 protection and a stated 50,000-hour MTBF; it was launched at the China International Industry Fair on 12 October 2026.

item.title: ROKAE AR3
item.description: Lightweight 7-DoF humanoid force-controlled arm from ROKAE with joint torque sensors and a cross-axis wrist, launched in March 2026 for service humanoids and embodied-AI platforms. It weighs 8 kg, carries 3 kg over a 650 mm radius with ±0.05 mm repeatability and is rated IP54.

item.title: ROKAE AR10
item.description: Heavy-duty 7-DoF humanoid force-controlled arm from ROKAE, launched in March 2026 for load handling and assembly on industrial humanoid and dual-arm platforms. It weighs 19.5 kg, carries 10 kg over an 815 mm radius with ±0.1 mm repeatability and is rated IP54.

item.title: FAIRINO ART7
item.description: Seven-axis industrial humanoid force-controlled arm from FAIRINO with full-joint force control and a crossed wrist, first shown at the World Robot Conference in August 2026 and also offered as the ART7-R7 dual-arm torso. It carries 7 kg (10 kg peak) over a 714 mm reach with ±0.03 mm repeatability and runs on 48 V DC.

item.title: FAIRINO ART14
item.description: Heavy-duty industrial humanoid force-controlled arm in FAIRINO's ART series, first shown at the World Robot Conference in August 2026 for automotive manufacturing, large-part handling and assembly. It carries 14 kg per arm with a 20 kg peak payload.

item.title: Jaka Robotics Zu50
item.description: High-payload collaborative robot from JAKA, premiered at the China International Industry Fair in October 2026 to extend the Zu series into heavy handling and palletizing. It carries 50 kg over a 2,100 mm reach with ±0.05 mm repeatability, weighs 160 kg and is rated IP65.

item.title: RealMan Robotics GEN62
item.description: Desktop six-axis arm from RealMan (Beijing) launched in October 2026 at a roughly 10,000 CNY price level for light automation, mobile manipulation, embodied-AI data collection and teaching. It weighs 3.5 kg, has a 2 kg rated payload (3.5 kg maximum at full reach), a 660 mm working radius, ±0.1 mm repeatability, all-harmonic drives and runs on 24 V DC.

item.title: RealMan Robotics ECO62
item.description: Ultra-compact embedded six-axis arm from RealMan with a base-integrated controller, released on 15 October 2026 under the 'Arm in Machine' concept for installation inside coffee stations, vending terminals and other equipment. It weighs 3.6 kg, carries 2 kg over a 425 mm working radius with ±0.1 mm repeatability and draws under 100 W typical at 24 V.

item.title: Elephant Robotics ultraArm P1
item.description: Four-axis desktop stepper-motor arm from Elephant Robotics launched in July 2026 as an upgrade of the ultraArm P340, aimed at education, research and light palletizing. It carries 650 g over a 360 mm working radius with ±0.1 mm repeatability, has collision detection and a 2.4-inch screen, and accepts pen, gripper, suction and laser-engraving tools. Elephant publishes no global price; regional prices and bundles differ.

item.title: Flexiv Enlight
item.description: New-generation lightweight adaptive robot arm series from Flexiv, launched at the FLEXIVERSE 2026 event in Shanghai on 20 March 2026 together with the Orion controller and MICO dual-arm platform. Every joint integrates multi-axis force sensing for whole-body skin-level contact perception, detecting up to seven simultaneous contact points with millimetre-level position and 0.5 N-level touch-force sensitivity.

item.title: Huayan Robotics Echo 5
item.description: Seven-axis humanoid arm in the Echo series from Huayan Robotics (formerly Han's Robot), launched in April 2026 for quadruped, humanoid and other embodied platforms. It has a coplanar crossed wrist, joint torque sensing in every joint, a 5 kg rated payload (6 kg peak), 735 mm maximum reach, ±0.03 mm repeatability, EtherCAT control at 48 V DC and native ROS 2 support.

item.title: Huayan Robotics Echo 15
item.description: Seven-axis humanoid arm in the Echo series from Huayan Robotics (formerly Han's Robot), launched in April 2026 for quadruped, humanoid and other embodied platforms. It has a coplanar crossed wrist, joint torque sensing in every joint, a 15 kg rated payload (16 kg peak), 854 mm maximum reach, ±0.05 mm repeatability, EtherCAT control at 48 V DC and native ROS 2 support.

item.title: Huayan Robotics HY 3
item.description: Seven-axis humanoid arm in the HY series from Huayan Robotics (formerly Han's Robot), launched in April 2026 for quadruped, humanoid and other embodied platforms. It has a non-coplanar crossed wrist, joint torque sensing in every joint, a 3.5 kg rated payload (4.5 kg peak), 650 mm maximum reach, ±0.02 mm repeatability, EtherCAT control at 48 V DC and native ROS 2 support.

item.title: Huayan Robotics HY 7
item.description: Seven-axis humanoid arm in the HY series from Huayan Robotics (formerly Han's Robot), launched in April 2026 for quadruped, humanoid and other embodied platforms. It has a non-coplanar crossed wrist, joint torque sensing in every joint, a 7 kg rated payload (8 kg peak), 670 mm maximum reach, ±0.03 mm repeatability, EtherCAT control at 48 V DC and native ROS 2 support.

item.title: Galaxea AI LEMO
item.description: Desktop dual-arm embodied-AI development platform from Galaxea (Xinghaitu), put on sale in October 2026 at a 49,999 CNY launch price. It combines two A1Z arms (14 DoF in total) with G1Z grippers, two wrist cameras and a top camera and a CCU controller, offering 3 kg rated / 5 kg peak payload per arm, ±0.1 mm repeatability, isomorphic leader-follower teleoperation and synchronized multimodal data collection.

item.title: ARX Robotics OpenX5 Bimanual Data-Collection Platform
item.description: Tabletop leader-follower teleoperation station from ARX Robotics with two X5 follower arms, two compact teaching arms and three cameras for recording two-arm demonstrations for VLA model training. Each follower arm has six joints plus a gripper, about 500 g payload, about 1 mm repeatability and a 200 Hz control loop; list price is 6,999 USD after a 5,999 USD launch offer.

item.title: AgileX Robotics OPEN NERO
item.description: Desktop dual-arm teleoperation and multimodal data-collection platform from AgileX Robotics built around two 7-DOF NERO arms (3 kg payload, 580 mm reach and ±0.1 mm repeatability per arm) with grippers opening 0-100 mm and an Intel i5 onboard PC. It records data in MCAP and LeRobot formats for robot-learning research.

item.title: AgileX Robotics OPEN PiPER
item.description: Lightweight desktop dual-arm teleoperation platform from AgileX Robotics using 6-DOF PiPER arms, aimed at bimanual manipulation, teleoperation data collection and embodied-AI prototyping with standardized components and rapid assembly.

item.title: AgileX Robotics PiPER-X
item.description: Version of the AgileX PiPER 6-DOF arm with a spherical wrist for manipulation in constrained spaces, offering 1.5 kg payload, 669 mm reach and ±0.1 mm repeatability; listed by AgileX in January 2026.

item.title: DISCOVER Robotics AIRBOT P7
item.description: 7-DOF research arm from DISCOVER Robotics launched on 23 July 2026 with a built-in D-Robotics Sunrise 5 chip (10 TOPS) and an 8-core Cortex-A55 processor for on-arm policy inference. It offers 3 kg payload, 640 mm reach, ±0.1 mm repeatability, brakes on every joint, gravity-compensated hand guiding and ROS 2, Python and C++ interfaces.

item.title: WLkata MiroMAX Core Kit
item.description: Six-axis desktop industrial-grade robot arm from WLKATA Robotics listed in July 2026 for automation teaching and CTE workcells. It has a 1 kg rated payload, 450 mm reach and ±0.05 mm repeatability, quick-change tools and Blockly, Python, ROS, MATLAB, C++ and Modbus control.

item.title: AUBO Robotics AUBO-G40
item.description: Adaptive heavy-payload collaborative robot in AUBO's G series, released on 30 April 2026, with torque sensors in every joint and a 96 V high-voltage power platform. It carries 42 kg over a 1,800 mm working radius with ±0.05 mm repeatability, reaches up to 5.4 m/s tool speed, weighs 109 kg and is rated IP67.

item.title: ROKAE AR5
item.description: The Taibai AR5 is a 7-DOF anthropomorphic force-control robotic arm from ROKAE (Beijing), part of the AR series alongside the AR3 and AR10. It weighs 10kg, has a 700mm reach, joint-level torque sensing, and is aimed at data collection, AI training and smart-factory tasks.

item.title: Epson AX6
item.description: The AX6 is Seiko Epson's first collaborative 6-axis industrial robot arm, unveiled in September 2026 and launched for sale in Japan in November 2026. It has a 900 mm reach, supports Python programming alongside no-code teaching, and is aimed at manufacturers wanting a cobot that works safely alongside people without full specialist programming expertise.

item.title: fruitcore robotics HORST600 G2
item.description: HORST600 G2 is the most compact 6-axis cobot in fruitcore robotics' German-made HORST family, built for pick-and-place and parts handling with a 7 kg maximum payload (5 kg nominal per VDI 2861-2) and 610 mm reach. It ships with an integrated control unit and touchscreen running the no-code horstOS software, floor/wall/ceiling/incline mounting, and IP54/IP65 protection.

item.title: fruitcore robotics HORST1000 G2
item.description: HORST1000 G2 is a German-made 6-axis cobot from fruitcore robotics billed as the strongest in its class, with a 16 kg payload and 1141 mm reach for machine-tending in harsh production environments. It integrates a control unit, touchscreen panel and the no-code horstOS automation software, with +/-0.05 mm repeatability.

item.title: fruitcore robotics HORST1500 G2
item.description: HORST1500 G2 is the largest 6-axis cobot in fruitcore robotics' German-made HORST line, with a 15 kg payload and 1485 mm reach for loading/unloading machine tools and palletizing. It carries IP54/IP65 ratings and ISO 6 cleanroom capability, and runs the no-code horstOS software with +/-0.05 mm repeatability.

item.title: ABB Robotics PoWa 10
item.description: PoWa 10 is part of ABB Robotics' PoWa cobot family launched in April 2026, built for long reach and high arm-load capacity in compact industrial spaces. It reaches top speeds of 5.8 m/s and runs on ABB's OmniCore controller with no-code programming via RobotStudio and Wizard Easy Programming, targeting machine tending, palletizing, screwdriving and arc welding.

item.title: ABB Robotics PoWa 13
item.description: PoWa 13 is part of ABB Robotics' PoWa cobot family launched in April 2026, one of six payload variants (7-30 kg) built for long reach and high arm-load capacity in compact industrial spaces. It reaches top speeds of 5.8 m/s and runs on ABB's OmniCore controller with no-code programming via RobotStudio and Wizard Easy Programming.

item.title: Altinay Robot Teknolojileri GRASS SR40
item.description: GRASS SR40 is a six-axis industrial robotic arm developed by Turkish company Altinay Robot Teknolojileri under the state-backed GRASS (Gelismis Akilli Sanayii Sistemleri) program, which designs and builds robot arms and their core components, including servo motors, drives and motion-control software, domestically in Turkey. It was publicly launched in May 2026 at the Istanbul Fair Center with Turkey's defence and technology ministers in attendance, and carries a 40 kg nominal (50 kg maximum) payload with a 2100 mm reach for manufacturing and heavy-industry automation lines.

item.title: Altinay Robot Teknolojileri GRASS SR80
item.description: GRASS SR80 is the higher-capacity sibling of the GRASS SR40, a six-axis industrial robotic arm developed in Turkey by Altinay Robot Teknolojileri under the government-backed GRASS domestic-robotics program and launched in May 2026. It carries an 80 kg nominal (90 kg maximum) payload with a 2300 mm reach, aimed at heavier automation lines across defence, heavy industry and automotive manufacturing.

item.title: Fastbrick Robotics Firehawk
item.description: Firehawk is FBR's autonomous refractory ladle-relining robot for the steelmaking industry, built on the company's Dynamic Stabilisation Technology to place insulating sand and refractory brick with consistent accuracy across a 10-metre reach. It removes workers from extreme-heat, confined-space ladle environments, runs one-touch operation from pre-approved lining designs, and can complete a full reline in as little as a day.

item.title: Jaka Robotics Zu35
item.description: JAKA Zu35 is a collaborative robot arm in JAKA Robotics' Zu series, rated for a 35 kg payload over a 2000 mm working reach. It has ±0.05 mm repeat positioning accuracy and IP65 protection, targeting material handling, palletizing, assembly, welding and inspection.

item.title: Dobot CR7HT
item.description: CR7HT is a high-performance collaborative robot in Dobot's new CRH series, announced in November 2026 at Dobot's Robotics Ecosystem Conference in Frankfurt. It carries a 7.5 kg payload with ±0.02 mm repeatability, weighs 22.4 kg, and reaches a J6 joint speed of 450°/s and TCP instantaneous speed of 7 m/s, using a 1000 Hz real-time control loop and vibration-suppression algorithms to keep motion jitter under 0.3 mm at full payload and speed.

item.title: Dobot CR12HT
item.description: CR12HT is the higher-payload model in Dobot's new CRH collaborative robot series, announced in November 2026 at Dobot's Robotics Ecosystem Conference in Frankfurt. It carries a 12 kg payload with ±0.03 mm repeatability, weighs 34.6 kg, and reaches a J6 joint speed of 450°/s and TCP instantaneous speed of 7 m/s, using a 1000 Hz real-time control loop and vibration-suppression algorithms to keep motion jitter under 0.3 mm at full payload and speed.

item.title: Dobot CR3AS
item.description: CR3AS is a collaborative robot arm in Dobot's CRS line, fitted with Dobot's SafeSkin collision-detection surface for close human-robot work. It weighs 16.5 kg, carries a 3 kg maximum payload over a 620 mm working radius (795 mm max reach), with ±0.02 mm repeatability and IP54 protection.

item.title: Dobot CR5AS
item.description: CR5AS is a collaborative robot arm in Dobot's CRS line, fitted with Dobot's SafeSkin collision-detection surface offering 5 levels of adjustable sensitivity for close human-robot work. It weighs 25 kg, carries a 5 kg maximum payload over a 900 mm working radius (1096 mm max reach), with ±0.02 mm repeatability and IP54 protection.

item.title: Dobot CR10AS
item.description: CR10AS is the wide-radius model in Dobot's CRS collaborative robot line, fitted with Dobot's SafeSkin collision-detection surface that senses objects up to 7 cm away and reacts within 0.01 s. It weighs 40 kg, carries a 10 kg maximum payload over a 1300 mm working radius (1525 mm max reach), with ±0.03 mm repeatability and IP54 protection.

item.title: Dobot CR5AF
item.description: CR5AF is a force-controlled collaborative robot in Dobot's CRAF series, built for precision automation tasks that need compliant force control. It carries a 5 kg maximum payload over a 900 mm working radius with ±0.02 mm repeatability.

item.title: Dobot CR10AF
item.description: CR10AF is a force-controlled collaborative robot in Dobot's CRAF series, built for precision automation tasks that need compliant force control. It carries a 10 kg maximum payload over a 1300 mm working radius with ±0.03 mm repeatability.

item.title: Dobot CR20AF
item.description: CR20AF is a force-controlled collaborative robot in Dobot's CRAF series, built for precision automation tasks that need compliant force control. It carries a 20 kg maximum payload over a 1700 mm working radius with ±0.05 mm repeatability.

item.title: Dobot CR5AP
item.description: CR5AP is a waterproof, dustproof collaborative robot in Dobot's CRA-IP68 series, rated IP68 for harsh industrial environments. It carries a 5 kg maximum payload over a 900 mm working radius.

item.title: Dobot CR10AP
item.description: CR10AP is a waterproof, dustproof collaborative robot in Dobot's CRA-IP68 series, rated IP68 for harsh industrial environments. It carries a 10 kg maximum payload over a 1300 mm working radius.
